name: wedf_weight_probe_8
notes: DESIGN ARTIFACT — BLOCKED-weight, NEVER RUN LIVE against the real policy (Phase-2 material). Shape: two prospective weight classes (w=1: sectors 64,128,192,256; w=3: sectors 320,384,448,512) interleaved in one batch. CANNOT run today: (a) trace_driver v3 does not parse a 'weight' field; (b) loader_q_wedf exposes no weight knob (ioext_cli_args.h common args only); (c) desc.weight is never assigned by iosched_build_desc (ioext_bpf_common.h:193-212) and never read by q_wedf.bpf.c — the W in WEDF has NO input path (EVOLUTION_PLAN.md §8 row 5.4 'weight 未实现 KNOWN'; Test_Design_IOExt.md ~371-378). INTENDED semantics once implemented (dl = arrival + 50ms/weight): w3 class dl ~16.7ms vs w1 class dl 50ms, gap 33ms > 5ms window -> strict EDF: all w3 reads before all w1 reads, sector ascending within each class -> 320,384,448,512,64,128,192,256. See expect/golden/wedf_weight_probe_intended.json. On the CURRENT policy the same trace would dispatch purely sector-ascending (64,128,...,512) — the measurable divergence is recorded by tests/io/q_wedf_model.py --divergence.
